limitations.data_source: raw (this skill never cleans or imputes; every number is recomputable from the raw table)
model_assumptions: lag-compensated Spearman window 0–10 rows (lead/lag beyond this window is invisible)
whole-period scoring assumes one dominant operating condition; use the regime table for segmented reading
Cpk treats within-sigma as MR̄/1.128 moving-range estimate

confounders.why: declared as covariate in analysis_context (may co-move with factors and responses)

conclusion.label: 波动
conclusion.statement: 该产线在本时段总体运行波动（53.9 分，C 级）：评估 8 个参数，检出 1761 个 SPC 违规剧集、7 项显著漂移；最需关注：thickness_gauge、haze_gauge、tdo_z4_temp。
